title: Vector Search & Rerank Playbook: Visual Guide, Stepper UX, and Variant Screenshots
creator: Aisha Raman
description: Design a compact, developer-focused visual playbook for the Embeddings + Rerank quickstart. Deliverables include: a two-pane stepper UI for onboarding, two pipeline diagrams (Minimal Starter and Advanced Rerank Tuning), three screenshot variants for docs (light, dark, high-contrast), and a set of annotated sample outputs for the docs and marketing hero card.
acceptance_criteria:
1) Stepper component designs and responsive specs delivered in Figma with component tokens and states.
2) Two annotated pipeline diagrams exported as SVG + PNG with captions and alt text.
3) Three product screenshots (light, dark, high-contrast) showing the quickstart flow and sample outputs, sized for docs hero (1200x600) and modal (800x480).
4) Accessibility notes and alt-copy for each image inline in the assets sheet.
5) Links to final Figma file, PRD, and resulting GH PR with screenshots attached.
tasks: Create stepper UX showing: Connect datasource -> Index embeddings -> Query + rerank -> Inspect results
Design Minimal Starter pipeline diagram (index + simple cosine similarity -> topK rerank)
Design Advanced Rerank Tuning pipeline (multi-stage candidate generation, lexical filter, metadata boosts, rerank model ensemble)
Produce three screenshot variants (light/dark/high-contrast) and annotate key UI elements in captions
Prepare sample outputs file (CSV-compatible) and screenshot showing 'explainability' popover for rerank scoring
Write alt-copy and short captions for docs and blog use
Export final assets and upload to Drive + link in PRD
